svg.title: Validation is a pipeline, and it collects every error in one pass
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Validation is a pipeline, and it collects every error in one pass” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A JSON payload card with two bad fields feeding a four-gate vertical pipeline: before-validators on the raw input, type coercion and Field constraints, after-validators on the typed value, and finally the cross-field model validator. An arrow trying to skip from gate one to gate three is crossed out in red. On the right, a ValidationError card lists both errors with their type, loc and msg, and bars show model_validate at 2.70 microseconds against json.loads plus validate at 5.10.
